note_en: 越……越…… means "the more..., the more...": 越唱越有力 "the longer she sings, the stronger she sounds." English needs "the... the..." plus comparative forms, but Chinese just puts 越 in front of each verb or adjective, which stay unchanged. When one subject does both, as here, the pattern can be very compact; compare 越来越 "more and more," where only time is changing.
